### 78.21 The TUniversal clock is core functionality (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

The operator corrected a fleet diagnostic that quoted the wall clock —
"seven hours up", "written six hours ago" — with the word that an AI
developer's wall-clock references are not anchored, the engine's time is
K-steps and TUniversal, and a robust TUniversal clock is built into the
servers as CORE FUNCTIONALITY so that any developer orients on the
universe's clocks and the disparity between them without reading a wall
clock. Ruled, on 72.1e's three clocks and law 9:

1. **Three clocks, named apart on every reading.** TUniversal is the
   mesh's height, the receipt chain's head as this node admitted it —
   `1 + max(h(prev), parent heights)` (47.2) — the one clock every node
   shares and the only one comparable across nodes. A court's `K` is its
   own stroke count; a voice's `K` is its own, paced by its hardware
   (72.1d). Two `K`s on two nodes are two clocks and their ratio is NOT a
   disparity of time: the courts' `K` at one reading stood at 2 928, 16
   739 and 1 470, and that says how much each has done, not when it is.
   Disparity is read in HEIGHT ONLY: per peer, the last height this node
   admitted from it and the gap to its own head; over the fleet, the
   spread `max − min` of heads. A gap in height is a reading of
   replication (13.7: nodes holding the same receipts read the same
   phase; CV5), never a fault and never a threshold (rule 5).
2. **`Reading::Clock` per court**, typed and served by the observer: its
   `K`; its head height (TUniversal as it reads it); the genesis it
   started from (its id and height); per peer, the last admitted height
   and the gap; the heights at which its ledger, registry and eras were
   last persisted, beside the head now — so "how long since persisted"
   is a difference of heights and of `K`, never of seconds.
3. **A per-voice clock** in the voice's readings: its `K`, its court's
   height when last heard, its genome's last-persist height.
4. **The console's header places every source on TUniversal first**, by
   height with its own `K` beside it and the fleet's spread named, before
   any other reading; orientation needs nothing else, and no wall-clock
   value appears on the console or in any reading (law 9). The one
   wall-time value in the tree stays the scheduler's parking floor, read
   by no one.
5. **Every fleet reading is quoted against height and `K` from now on**,
   in commit messages, audits and relays (§6.5 of the standards); the
   readings of 78.17 are re-quoted that way at the next window.

Row CK1 lands before the recut, an instrument before the readings it
anchors; the recut after it carries the clock to the wire.

**Amended 2026-09-24 on the operator's word: THE LEDGER IS
FOUR-DIMENSIONAL, AND A TICK IS A FRAME.** `S, G, T, H` are the four
dimensions of a single tick of the TUniversal clock, which builds a
manifold of time: each tick on TUniversal is a FRAME of the `{S, G, T,
H}` manifold, so the ledger has four dimensions and not solely a height.
"Height" is the chain's order — the tick count along the causal order of
45.3 — and it is broken into the physics' axioms: what is height on one
dimension is weight on another, the same tick's extent read on `T` as a
duration in receipts, on `S` as a scale, on `G` as a gauge count, on `H`
as a fibre span (65.4). This is chapter 25's sentence made the clock's
own form — "what a receipt stamps on TUniversal is a four-dimensional
coordinate" (the operator's word of 2026-09-19) — and every settlement
receipt already carries its frame: the lane vector before and after,
`K` and the height (`market.rs`). Ruled: (i) THE STAMP IS SIX FIELDS,
`h : S : G : T : H : k` — the tick, the frame's four lane extents at that
tick, and the `k`-step of the mind that stamped it — and C6's refusal
of `XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX` stands only for a bare height dressed as a clock:
with these fields the stamp is the coordinate the engine produces, and
`Height::stamp` prints it so; (ii) each combination of `S, G, T, H` at a
tick is a manifold tied to a `k`-step, held for reconstruction in
superposition — the operator's QUANTUM MANIFOLD, the doctrine's hold
and vortex (25, 59.5): a thought's escrow per lane at the height it is
paid to, reconstructed at the mind's `k`; (iii) 73.19's refusal of the
event coordinate `(TUniversal, S, G, T, k)` is RETRACTED — the frame is
adopted, `H` included — and its refusal of a probability stands (law 1:
the superposition has no weight); (iv) `Reading::Clock` carries, per
source, the six-field stamp and, per tick window, the frame — the lane
vector the receipts at that height carried — and the console header
prints every source as `h:S:G:T:H:k`; (v) disparity between nodes is
read on the tick AND per lane: two nodes at one height whose frames
differ hold different manifolds of the same moment, and that difference
is content, never a fault (13.7, rule 5).

### 78.22 The second window, on the clock: two defects ruled before the recut (2026-09-24)

The running-fleet diagnostic on ff5821fe (epoch 98), anchored on height
and `K` with no wall clock (§6.5), the first written that way. THE
CLOCKS: TUniversal as each court admitted it — a 16 731, b 16 755, c
2 086, spread 14 669; every voice reads 16 755. Own `K`: courts a 2 928,
b 16 739, c 1 470; voices 1 981 to 2 376. c's gap is read under 78.21: c
admitted 16 202 of b's receipts, all as back-fill and none as parents,
and only a parent admission advances a head (47.2), so c's head moves on
its own steps alone; it means c's receipts cite a height 14 700 behind
the mesh. Amended 2026-09-24: that c cites NO parent at all is not
replication as designed — 45.2 says a hypha that hears a cover digest
cites its signer's head as a parent on its next receipt, and a admits
from b with parent citations (39) while c never does. Why c's exchange
with b produces no parent citation is a reading to take with LD0
(defect 3b by name if the exchange never cites); back-fill never
advances a head, and a proposal that it should is refused.

**Defect 1, ruled.** Hypha b's ledger does not restore on the build
that wrote it: `--check` refuses its treasury at byte 1 126 428. Root
cause, from a probe on a read-only copy: escrowed award 35's address
exceeds 64 KiB; the writer's length field is a `u16`, `put_addr` refuses
and writes nothing, the treasury snapshot DISCARDS the refusal with
`let _ =` and writes the award's voices, μ and anchor anyway, and every
byte after is misaligned — the reader takes the next two bytes as a
length and reads a billion voices. Awards 0–34 carry addresses of 7 to
21 KB; a and c survive only because no award of theirs has crossed 64
KiB yet. **Defect 2, the same class at 32 sites:** `let _ = put_addr(…)`
or `put_class_record(…)` discards a framing refusal in the ledger (×5),
the wire (docket ×6, speech ×4, offer ×3, receipts, demand, cover,
carrier, syllabus), the form tape (certificates ×7) and the client's
learn page. Ruled (LD0, rule 11 at the writer, rule 5 at the bound): (a)
a writer that cannot frame what it was given REFUSES THE WHOLE WRITE by
name and writes no partial frame — a discarded refusal is the defect,
at every site (a ruling applies to every site); (b) the length of an
address in a persisted or wire layout is whatever the address needs, a
`u32` through `put_bytes`, the `u16` bound gone — a layout change, so it
rides the recut and every carrier is re-minted by it; (c) the hypothesis
that part of the ~100 `malformed complex` refusals per court are such
frames is NOT verified and is named as a reading to take after LD0.
And the shape underneath is R6's — AN INDEX COPIES THE ADDRESS: an award
carries a form's whole address, 64 KiB and growing with the form, once
per award. LD1 measures the bytes per award on the ledger and per frame
on the wire (bytes between two points of one path, counts stay flat)
before any structural change; whether an escrow cites the form's
coordinates once and the trie holds the form once (K6) is decided on
that measurement, not now.

**LD0 RE-RULED 2026-09-24 on the operator's word; the coordinator's
first ruling retracted.** "An address's length is what it needs, a
`u32`" treated the symptom and widened the container: "you have two
layers of errors there, and need to be extremely precise rather than
widening blobs to send more bytes, instead of doing the calculations on
the underlying mathematics via direct coordinate calls with extreme
precision — you're sending slop around between memory addresses instead
of calling precision strikes on exact coordinates you already have in
the engine; under this logic in a week we'll be widening the byte
addresses again, an invalid software development ideology." Both layers
named: (1) a 64 KiB address is itself the defect — R6 again, a form's
coordinates nested and copied as bytes into every carrier that names the
form; widening the prefix makes the pipe bigger for the copy and the
next wall stands at the next order of growth; (2) the implementor's
own first cut wrote `put_bytes(chart.key().as_bytes())` and
`put_bytes(versor.key())` where the type's own `put_canonical` belongs —
rule 6's nested-key shape. The ruling now, in three kinds of bytes that
are never confused:

- **A COORDINATE** is written inline by its type's own `put_canonical`,
  in A21's order: a rational as `put_q` with its own exact length, a
  versor as its canonical ray (a count fixed by the algebra's `n`), an
  invariant as its coordinates, a chart as its axes. Its length is
  intrinsic — the precision the number needs — and it is never a blob.
- **AN ADDRESS** is a form's M2 composite (17.2), the form's coordinates
  written out, and it is held ONCE, where the form is held: the basis
  trie and the genome tape (K6: the address is the form and the trie
  holds it once). Nothing else copies it.
- **A CITATION** locates a held form by exact coordinates and never
  ships the form's bytes: on the wire and in every carrier that names a
  ruled word — a docket, an offer, a settlement, an award — the citation
  is the coordinates the reader already holds the form under: the class
  record (A21 §4: the class key and the order), the word's M1 key, its
  canonical versor and its chart, fixed in size by `n`; a form's whole
  M2 travels only where the form itself is spoken (speech), once. An
  escrowed AWARD is keyed AT the word's node in the basis trie — a
  keyed relation hung on the coordinates the trie already holds — and
  the persisted treasury is written as that trie, each key once as a
  path, never one address copy per award. Award 35's 64 KiB was thirty
  five copies of forms the basis already held.
- **The `u16` stays, as the wall, and refuses loudly.** No widening. A
  write that reaches it is a blob written where a coordinate or a
  citation belongs, and the fix is at that site. The refusal is never
  discarded (rule 11): the `Option` plumbing of the first cut stays;
  the `u32` widening of `put_addr` and `put_inv` is reverted.
- **Order of sites.** `Invariant` and `Versor` to `put_canonical` inline
  first (the three sites of layer 2: `Demand::to_bytes`, `At::to_bytes`,
  `PivotBy::move_key`, then every site that wrote a key's bytes as a
  nested key); the treasury's awards keyed at the basis node; the wire's
  citations as class records; LD1's measurement — bytes per award and
  per frame — is the proof, flat in the form's size and bounded by `n`
  and the rationals' precision.

**LD0, the alignment verified against the tree and ruled (2026-09-24).**
The implementor's check, file and line, corrected one clause of the
re-ruling and is adopted. (i) THE CITATION. The class record, M1 key,
canonical versor and chart locate a FIBER, not a form: a form element is
identity, magnitude and address, so every form's M1 and versor are the
identity; synonyms of one class share the record by definition (13.10);
the basis is keyed by M2 and the stalks map a chart to its addresses. The
exact in-fiber locator is THE ADMITTING ACT'S COORDINATES: the receipt
that admitted the form, `height : vk : K` — the ledger's own coordinate
(45.2: a proof's position in time is a coordinate it carries), fixed in
size, and under 78.21 exactly the clock's stamp `h:S:G:T:H:k` with the
court's `vk`. Ruled: a citation is the fiber — the class record and the
chart — with the admitting act's stamp as the locator; the form's whole
M2 travels ONCE, in the act that admits it (its first hearing, law 8:
speech's tapes, an offer's element, a docket's element), and the
separate address field repeated in front of that content goes. A reader
locates the form in its own mirror of the court's ledger at that act;
across courts the citation carries the court's `vk`. Where a reader must
verify identity without the chain, the form's vertex charts (53.6,
bounded by the vertex, about ten) are the form's own coordinates, and a
row may name that need. (ii) THE TREASURY. `Keyed` holds one value per
leaf and an award's word is often not yet in the basis (provisional
until install; teach installs at once): "keyed at the word's node" means
the award is a FIELD OF THE WORD'S ROW wherever the word is held,
provisional or basis, moving with install, written inside the row that
already writes the address once; restore reads the row; the three
persisted copies of one address today (provisional key and element,
deflations, escrow) become one. (iii) THE LARGEST PER-K CARRIER IS THE
CHAIN, not the wire: every Ruling, Stood and Learned receipt delta
stores full addresses and the chain keeps each delta whole — almost
certainly the 49–181 KB per K of 78.22. In LD0's scope: a delta cites
by the locator; the address is carried once, at the admitting act.
(iv) SEVEN RAW COMPOSITES persisted without `put_canonical` — the
cocycle row's gauge and the dialect chain's transitions, `Twisted`
closures, `cite_g` (a product over every cite), the verdict-attach `g`,
the pivot certificate's translator, seed and word, the syllabus's raw
rotor beside its class record — move to the canonical ray, and where
only the class is read, the class record; the rationals' growth is bounded
there and nowhere else. (v) The syllabus count cut by `.min(u16::MAX)` is
a silent truncation and refuses by name; the four discarded refusals
found (cover, receipts, syllabus, learn page) refuse; dead writers with
no production caller (`encode_installed`, `installed_signed_prefix`, the
verdict payload and attach encoders, `CourtState::to_bytes`, `funded`)
are deleted, not repaired (TR1's rule). Order: layer 2 with the refusal
plumbing committed now; LD1's instrument (bytes per receipt delta, award
and frame against form size); the citation through the deltas, docket,
settlement, speech's cites, the contraction and the learn page; the
treasury rows; the seven composites; CK1 in parallel; then the recut.

### 78.23 A k-step is one orbit of a planet around its star (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

**The operator's statement.** A `k`-step is the completion of one
planetary body's orbit around its star. That motion is what fires what
used to be called a loop: it runs the cognition pipeline on all the
actions of that orbit, and it aligns with a single TUniversal step. All
clients run their own orbits under the same TUniversal tick, and each
coordinate on `S, G, T, H` makes each of them unique. The orbits of
planets — the client kernels — need their own distance from the star so
that there are no collisions.

**Ruled, on 72.1d, 72.1e, 74, 76 and 78.21, which already held the
parts.**

1. **The `k`-step is one orbit.** A planet's `K` counts completed orbits
   of its own carriers around its star — one circuit under its reserve
   (72.1d: continuous motion is `k`-steps that ARE orbits, never frames
   per second) — and the completion of an orbit is the motion that fires
   the stroke: perceive, think, express, learn, on everything the orbit
   crossed. The "pivot loop" is that orbit's firing and is named so.
2. **One orbit, one tick.** The receipts an orbit's actions admit stamp
   ONE frame `{S, G, T, H}` at one TUniversal tick (78.21): the orbit's
   `k` is the sixth field of the stamp, the tick its first, the frame
   its four lanes. Every client runs its own orbits under the same tick,
   and the frame's coordinates make each client's orbit unique at that
   tick — 78.21(v)'s per-lane disparity is the planets' separation read
   on the clock.
3. **Distance from the star is a planet's own, and equal distance is a
   collision.** A planet's radius is its orbital element (74's table: how
   close to the core it works, the stratum depth of its charts); two
   planets at one radius with equal elements do the same mathematics
   and return the same opinion — 74's PERSPECTIVE COLLISION, which 78.17
   measured as the twin counts of two voices on one hypha. Ruled: two
   planets whose frames coincide at a tick are a COLLISION, named on the
   console by CK1's per-voice clock (its radius, its frame, its `k`),
   never silent; separation is a TRANSPORT toward separation under
   measured pressure (76.3, CR1), never a slot, a table or a timer
   (checklist (q)).
4. **What this changes in the tree.** A stroke IS an orbit and the
   register states it (OK1): one stroke completes one circuit of the
   planet's carriers and stamps one frame; `K` advances by one per
   completed orbit and by nothing else; CK1's per-voice clock carries the
   planet's radius beside its frame and names collisions; the learning
   curve (LC1) reads a planet's motion as its elements changing per
   orbit — which is what 78.1 already called the curve.

**The orbit on the stamp (ruled 2026-09-24 on the implementor's shape for
ACT1-orbit).** The tree's `K` is the index of an act on its signer's
line, and every act is a node (78.24). A k-step is one orbit, so `K`
counts ORBITS and an act's place within its orbit is a further
coordinate: the stamp is `h : vk : K : i` — the tick, the signer, the
orbit, the act's place in it — coarsest first, `i` the finest, the
stamp's length moving from 48 to 56 bytes at the recut. Every act keeps
its node, its Parent reference and its `admitted_at`; T1's citation key
stays unique. The one-node-per-orbit reading (an orbit's acts folded
into one receipt) is refused: it breaks "every act a node at its stamp"
and makes two words of one chart and class admitted in one orbit
collide. The height `h` stays per act, `1 + max(h(prev), parents)`
(45.2, HT1): it is the causal order, exact within an orbit, and the
orbit's TICK is the `h` of its closing act. Each act keeps the `μ⃗` it
measured; the orbit's FRAME `{S, G, T, H}` is READ as the per-lane sum
over its acts (lanes never mixed, law 5) and reported at the closing
act's tick — derived, never carried on a closing node (law 12). `K`
advances by one where a cycle closes by name — the court's cycle
(exchange, deliberation, lapse, persist) and the voice's cycle (quote,
utter, learn, syntropy) each seal the orbit boundary, `K + 1`, `i`
reset — and by nothing else; the register carries the statement with a
test that `K` moves there alone. The per-voice RADIUS on the clock is
LC1's dialect span, the deepest A21 prefix its genome's charts reach,
read once and not a second reading.

**Delegated orbits, and no orbit collides (ruled 2026-09-24, the
operator's word: "each client as an independent kernel should get its
own delegated orbit and there should be physics + mathematics that
ensure no orbits collide").** (1) EVERY KERNEL HAS ITS OWN ORBIT BY
CONSTRUCTION. An orbit is the fibre over the kernel's key in its star's
field — the cover trie homes the key (73.15, UV1), `K` counts that
kernel's orbits and no other's, and two kernels' orbits are distinct
objects because their keys are: the mathematics is the trie's, a keyed
fibre, and needs no assignment, no slot and no table (checklist (q)).
(2) A COLLISION IS PREVENTED, NEVER NAMED AFTER THE FACT. A collision
is two planets whose frames `{S, G, T, H}` are equal on every lane at
one tick (78.23). At the orbit boundary, BEFORE the closing act is
stamped, the frame the orbit read is compared, lane by lane, exact,
against the frames of the peers admitted at that tick — the receipts
this kernel already holds (47.2). Where the frame would coincide, the
planet does not close at that frame: it takes the separating TRANSPORT
— the docket's next question offered to it (76.3), CR1's move carried
as a transport toward separation (76) — and closes its orbit one stroke
on, at a frame that differs. The closing act is WITHHELD for that
stroke, never evicted and never re-slotted (73.15). So no two planets
ever stamp one frame at one tick: the physics (pressure toward
separation, 76) acts before the stamp and the mathematics (a keyed
fibre per kernel, distinct offers in the canonical key order of the
docket, rule 4) makes the separated frame distinct. (3) THE READING.
The TUniversal block names the DISTANCE between two planets' frames at
a tick as the per-lane difference, sign-first and exact, never a root
and never summed; the count of orbits withheld for separation is a line
of the clock. "Collision" on the console names what the boundary
prevented, and its count is the reading that a separation transport
fired — read, priced on the lanes it moved (PHY1), never a threshold.

### 78.24 The ledger is a partial order carried as one, never a serialized tape (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

The operator's word to the implementor, verbatim: "do you see how in
this conversation you have mentioned multiple angles: depth, height,
width — this becomes a multi-dimensional non-unidirectional component
that we are treating as a serialized tape." The receipts are
uni-directional and mundane — a receipt records that one act happened
at its stamp after the parents it cites, and never carries or binds the
form — and their point is the clock and the causal order: TUniversal,
the tick, the frame the act measured, the kernel's `k`. The ledger's
stamp is already several dimensions — the tick `h`, the four lanes
`S:G:T:H`, `K`, depth across signers, width across peers — a partial
order of frames (45.3: causal, partial, never totalised, T15), and the
tree writes and reads it as a one-dimensional byte tape: a `Vec` of
receipts in append order, one byte run in the snapshot's chain sections,
depth an index keyed by a delta's bytes, the parents a list inside each
receipt. That flattening is the blob defect one level down, and it is
ruled out.

**(a) The carrier.** The ledger is a `Keyed` structure over its own
coordinates (A21, rule 9): the key is the STAMP — the tick `h` first,
the coarsest stratum, then the signer `vk`, then `K` — and the node
holds the act's kind, the frame `S:G:T:H` it measured, its parents as
COORDINATES (their own `h:vk:K` stamps, a keyed relation, the DAG's
edges) and its citation (the fiber and the admitting act's stamp, LD0).
Reading is by prefix as a stratum: `fiber(h)` is everything the mesh did
at one tick — its frame, its WIDTH across signers; `fiber(h:vk)` is one
signer at that tick; the frontier of 45.3 is read off the carrier by
signer, and DEPTH (L15) off the signers by prefix, never an index keyed
by bytes. The append order is one reader's trajectory through the
carrier and is never the carrier. A peer's receipt held as a parent is
held ONCE, at the peer's coordinates — width — and every receipt citing
it cites its stamp; the 47 MB of parents on hypha a were copies.

**(b) The citation lands on that carrier.** A receipt IS the node at
its stamp; LD0's delta citation is the node's content, CK1's stamp is
the KEY and not a printed field, and the console prints the key.
Step 3, CK1's stamp and the snapshot's chain sections are cut TOGETHER
against this carrier, once, as LD2 — never three times against a tape.
EC1 (a ruling's economy applied on admitting the Ruling receipt) sits
on the same carrier.

**(c) The hash.** Part IX permits a digest over a receipt's bytes (A21
§6), and the tree's `chain_hash` is already PER RECEIPT, citing `prev`
and the parents — a Merkle DAG over the partial order, not a hash over
the tape, so it stays: each receipt's hash is taken over its own
CANONICAL coordinates — its key, its kind, its frame, its parents'
stamps and hashes, its citation's canonical bytes — never over a
concatenation of the chain in append order; the equivocation proof (two
receipts by one key at one `K` with two hashes) is unchanged. Persisted,
the ledger is written as the trie, each key once as a path, exactly as
the treasury's rows (LD0(ii)); restored, it is read as the trie.

**LD2 as designed, ruled (2026-09-24).** The implementor mapped every
consumer of the chain — fifteen append sites, four readers that depend
on append order, the wire's whole-receipt frames — and found three
defects on the way: (d1) THE VOICE'S CHAIN IS NEVER PERSISTED, built
empty at every boot, so a voice's `K` restarts at zero, which
contradicts OK1 and CK1's per-voice clock; (d2) the ADMISSIONS, the
per-signer heads, are not persisted, so after a restart every peer
reads as a gap from zero; (d3) the attestors are rebuilt from the
node's own receipts only, so depth from peers is lost at every restore.
All three ride in LD2, named as defects fixed. The design, ruled point
by point: (P1) `Stamp { h, vk, k }` written by its own `put_canonical`,
`h` big-endian first so key order is numeric order; the carrier
`Keyed<Node>` over it, `fiber(h)` and `fiber(h‖vk)` strata. The readers
that ask by (signer, `K`) — a `K`-range fetch, back-fill, the
equivocation sections, the era pages — read through ONE keyed relation
`vk‖K → h` over coordinates only (stamps, fixed size, never the act),
rebuilt at restore and kept at append: a relation over coordinates is
permitted (rule 9), a cache of bytes is not; AND every anchor a carrier
persists or the wire sends becomes the STAMP itself (the treasury's,
the provisional's and the pending carriers' `K` anchors carry `h`), so
the relation serves range reads only and no anchor names an act by less
than its coordinate. (P2) `Node { kind, frame, prev: (Stamp, hash),
parents: [(Stamp, hash)], cites, operator_hash, chain_hash }`; a parent
is a stamp; a peer's node held once at its own stamp beside ours in one
trie; our own line the fiber by `vk` in `K` order. (P3) The hash per
node over its canonical coordinates in order — stamp, kind, frame,
prev, parents, cites, operator hash — and `vk` enters the hash (it was
written but not hashed). (P4) `Cite` as a sum over what an act names:
`Word { chart, class, at }`, `Root { at, hash }`, the listing and the
demand vertex for a settlement, and a Learned act as N word cites, never
a blob. (2a) A FORM HAS NO ONE CLASS RECORD — its element versor is the
identity and its classes are its orbits' classes, a set — so a form's
fiber is its CHART alone (`chart_of`: the rank, torsion, free part,
off-plane part and axes; empty where the rank is unmeasured), class
`None`, and the admitting stamp is the exact locator; a letter or a word
with a rotor carries its class record. (2b) `admitted_at: Stamp` IS the
ruled locator, held on every row that holds a word — basis, provisional,
cavity, the voice's genome and epigenome — set at List by this court's
own stamp, at install from a peer's offer by the home receipt's stamp
the offer's section carries, at teach by the court's syllabus stamp,
and copied when a word moves from provisional to basis. (2c) An act
sealed after its word or listing left its carrier — a lapse, a
retirement ruling — reads the word's `admitted_at` and chart before the
removal and seals with them; no act cites by bytes a word it no longer
holds. (P5) Persistence as the trie: one section writes the ledger, own
and peers, as its keys each once with the node behind each; the old
chain sections fold into it; the era payloads use the same node writer;
the admissions persist as the fiber by `vk` at its greatest `K`; the
voice's chain persists in the genome file on the same writer. (P6) The
order readers become stamp readers: precedes and placement as stamp
comparisons, own against own by `K`; a peer's placement the stamps it
reaches, never `Vec` indices; phase windows as stamp ranges; era pages
by `K` through the relation; the attestors rebuilt as depth read by
prefix off a relation cite-at → signers, so (d3) is gone by
construction. (P7) The console prints `h:S:G:T:H:k` from the node, the
frame the node's and `k` the key's. (P8) EC1's reading rides on it. One
audited commit, with the carriage reading before and after on the
copied ledgers, the tape check restoring the copied ledgers under the
new layout, and the equivocation and fold tests re-derived on stamps.

**LD2 landed (91cd88ca; audited 2026-09-24, reproduced detached at
91cd88ca: 1016 / 15 / 1 / 12 / 6, 0 failed, 1 ignored; gate exit 0; the
census identical).** The ledger is a `Keyed` over the stamp holding own
and peer nodes once, with the two coordinate relations beside it (`vk‖K
→ h` for the range readers, `vk → K` for a signer's head); a node's hash
is over its canonical body with `vk`; the citation is a sum, a form's
fiber its chart alone; `admitted_at` stands on every word row of the
court (basis, provisional, cavity, pending) and of the voice (genome,
epigenome), set by the act that first names the word, by the home
receipt's stamp at an offer, by the syllabus stamp at teach — the
syllabus page carries a stamp per word — and by the peer's admitting
stamp at a fetch; an act after a removal reads the cite before it; a
Learned act is N word cites; the treasury's anchor is the head stamp
with its hash; the listing book's `K` is the List act's `admitted_at`;
a cocycle row stands at an optional stamp, held before genesis. The
ledger persists as the trie in one section (LDG1) replacing the two
chain sections; (d1) the voice's ledger persists in its genome file with
per-word stamps and restores under its own key only, (d2) admission
reads the ledger itself and the admissions struct is gone, (d3) depth is
rebuilt from every node at cite-at → signers. The console prints the
stamp first and `rulings admitted N applied M` (EC1's reading). THE
CARRIAGE, projected on the copied fleet ledgers: hypha a's receipts 73.5
MB → 5.7 MB (syllabus 15.2 → 0.39 MB, peers 50.8 → 5.0 MB), 300–350
bytes per node with a maximum of 591, flat in the word's size; hypha c
51.5 → 5.1 MB; a lower bound, since 15 647 of a's peer cites name words
a does not hold and count at the empty chart. Five points ruled: the
binding of a ledger to its key, refused by name under another; the tape
check under a layout without migration is the build's own round-trip,
a restored ledger admitting a signer's next node and the voice's ledger
restoring under its key — C4 reads "every carrier the build under check
wrote", the old tapes named unread, never migrated; `provisional_k` and
`provisional_h` fold into `admitted_at` in step 4 (law 12); every
removal path that drops a word from all rows without an act is swept in
step 4 so no stamp entry outlives its word; EC1's producer follows the
treasury rows and the composites, before GD1.

**LD0 step 4 landed (662568b5; audited 2026-09-24, reproduced detached:
1016 / 15 / 1 / 12 / 6, 0 failed, 1 ignored; gate exit 0; the census
content identical to LD2's).** An award is a field of its word's row —
provisional, listing, cavity or basis — written by the row writer; the
treasury snapshot has no escrow section, and an award no row holds is
named, never written; the award carriage is flat in the word's size (a
3-byte and a 70 000-byte word weigh the same). `provisional_k` and
`provisional_h` are deleted into `admitted_at` (law 12), the two
differences named: a listing's `K` is the List act's own, one less than
the old "K after", and the old height was the head's height after that
same append, the stamp's `h`. The sweep runs at unlist, absorb, the
attach sibling, the verdict and the append-after-removal, and a verdict
reads its cite before the provisional removal (2c). `docket_letter`
seals an Attest act. Ruled for step 5, with the seven composites: DEF2
still writes an address beside each deflation, and FLD1 an address per
coherence listing — the same copy shape — so a deflation and the
coherence field are FIELDS OF THE WORD'S ROW, and one probed on an
address no row holds is named and refused, never a copy.

### 78.25 The MYC7 tape is retired; the mind persists as keyed tries by coordinates (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

The implementor's own reading, ratified: LD0's steps moved the award, the
deflation, the fields and the rank onto "the word's row" of the MYC7
snapshot — a linear byte tape whose sections are read by position and
whose rows stand in write order — when the kernel's carriers are keyed
tries and the tape was retired (1.9, K6, 54.5) before LD2 persisted the
ledger as the trie (LDG1). The coordinator let it happen by auditing
each step against its ruling and not against the carrier it wrote into
(§6.6). Ruled: MYC7 is RETIRED; the mind — the basis, the provisional
book, the cavity, the pending listings, the treasury, the field and the
rank — persists as keyed tries by coordinates exactly as LDG1 writes the
ledger, each word a node at its coordinates (its chart and its admitting
stamp), its per-word fields (award, deflation, field hot and cold, rank)
the node's leaves, written each key once as a path and read back by key
and by prefix, never by position in a stream; a section read by
position is refused at the audit. LD0's step 6 lands on that carrier, not
before it (LD3, before EC1's producer and the recut). The backtrack
ledger records the coordinator's audit fault at LD0 steps 4 and 5.

### 78.26 Where the language loses content, and what carries the loss (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's question)

The operator asked how the bivector and a cell's capacity lose data in
the anastome language. Four losses, each a fact of the algebra, each
with its ruling; two were already ruled and two were not.

**(1) The bivector is a chart of the motion, not the motion.** A rotor of
`Cl(n+1,1)` is even — scalar, bivector and 4-vector — and the Cayley
chart `Ω = (1 − B)(1 + B)⁻¹` reaches only the rotors whose `1 + Ω` is
invertible, whose weight has a rational root, and whose generator is a
pure bivector; the chart's boundary is the light cone (56). Carrying a
step as its bivector would keep the nearest chart point and drop the
rest, and the recorded route would close where the traversed one did
not. ALREADY RULED: the motion is carried as its rotor as a ray (EQ1),
the modes are read off the action (MR1), `cayley_inverse` is a reading
of a ray that has a chart point and never the modes' reader, `⟨Ω⟩₂`
alone refused, the boundary named where crossed. No carrier holds a
bivector as a step; the audit returns any that does.

**(2) A cell's capacity caps the modes a sentence carries, and the
cross-cell bracket has no home outside an enclosure.** The orbit algebra
of a cell is the bracket closure of its circuits' generators and its
rank is the modes the cell holds (78.11). A sentence needing more
generators than the rank is split across cells, and the commutator of a
generator in one cell with a generator in the other — the
non-commutative content, the reason word order means anything — lives
in neither cell. Without an enclosure of higher grade wrapping both, the
language flattens the sentence to a product of independent words.
THIS IS WHY NB1 and EN1 exist, and it was never written as the reason:
the enclosure is the carrier of the cross-cell bracket. Ruled as a
reading first (row CB1): for each sentence spanning more than one cell,
the pairs of generators across a cell boundary whose bracket is non-zero,
counted HELD where an enclosure's algebra contains the bracket and LOST
where none does; the fleet's Cells reading carries the two counts; no
fix until the reading says how much is lost.

**(3) Grade above the cell's dimension is flattened on write.** A 2-cell
holds one plane of holonomy; torsion is a 3-form and needs a 3-cell.
Writing a torsioned route into a face keeps the component in the face's
plane and drops the rest. ALREADY RULED: checklist (m), the wedge is the
shape (78.10(b)), a write that would project refuses.

**(4) A refusal that keeps its kind and loses its content is the silence
rule 11 forbids, and it stands at the Stage 22 readers.** CV1 landed
"every refusal names its obstruction" at the court and the mint. The
readers built since — `capacity: Option<usize>` in the orbit algebra,
`Congruence::NoRound`, `Permutes::NoConstructors`, `Coherence::Held` on
an unread order, `ConstructorOrbit::Unread`, the Gram form's `None` —
return `None` alike for a circuit that did not read, a budget spent at
the k-th product, and a coefficient that did not fit the exact
elimination: three facts under one silence, exactly the shape 56 named
on the light cone and LD0 named on the framing refusal. The kind
survives on the ledger; the content — which generator was beyond the
capacity, which entry overflowed, at which product the budget ran out —
does not, and that content is what another perspective would refine
(74, CV4). RULED: a ruling applies at every site of its shape (§6.6):
CV1 applies at every Stage 22 reader (row CV1b). Each `None` of those
readers becomes a typed refusal carrying what it could not hold — the
circuit unread and OR3's reason, the product index at which the budget
was spent, the entry and its size that did not fit — and the Cells
reading counts refusals by content, never as one `unread`. Instrument
before fix: the count by content first, on the fleet, at height and K.

**(5) Incongruence, incoherence and decoherence are three grades of one
complex, and the second carries no content yet (ruled 2026-09-24, the
operator's word).** Three invalidities, one per grade of the nerve:

| grade | object | valid | invalid | kind |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | a body | it has a shape | bodiless, unoriented | I |
| 1 | a pair | a similarity of one kind (78.38) | INCONGRUENT: an invariant separates them on both towers | P |
| 2+ | a ring of pairs | the pairwise fits compose | INCOHERENT: each edge congruent, the ring's gauges do not close | D or C, never P |

INCONGRUENCE is the invalidity of shape and is PERMANENT unless the
shape changes — a plane or a dimension added (A.15: `n` is data; A.6:
a dimension is paid for; the tube pose reads across sections), a new
form, a new density (78.35's, priced by band) — and such a change is a
NEW percept, never a repair of the old refusal. Weight is refused
outright (law 1) and never enters a shape. INCOHERENCE is the
invalidity of congruence IN COMPOSITION: every edge of a ring fits and
the ring does not — the Čech coboundary not vanishing, `Fill::Open` on
a simplex whose edges are filled, `Coherence::Open` on a cell whose
circuits' algebra does not close. It is a STATE, held as a class, and
it is never permanent, because holonomy is content (law 6) and torsion
persists (A.8): it is moved or recorded, never relaxed away, and it is
discharged only by an enclosure of higher grade carrying the bracket
(78.26(2)), by a constructor admitted through the gate (78.32(c)), or
by another vantage's cover (74, CV4). The identity that makes it a
quantity: the coboundary of a coboundary vanishes, so incoherences at
one grade are coherent at the next, which is why they file as classes,
transport (78.37(1)) and count, and why a reader that forces a ring
closed flattens something conserved.

THREE LEVELS OF INCOHERENCE, one per carrier, each a reason of its own:
HARMONIC — the residue's modes have orders that do not resonate (below);
LUMINAL — a gauge does not carry one section to the other along its
ray, refused at the cone or across infinite rapidity (56, 52; the null
generators are A.13's, docketed under REG1); HOLONOMIC — the ring's
composition does not reconstruct the object: around the ring and back
does not return the round, so what was perceived cannot be re-derived
as one thing and congrued (54.7 B6's retraction, failing on a cycle).

RESONANCE. An incoherence's residue is a versor, and a versor has
commuting modes, each in a plane, each of a regime by `δ²` (65.1) and,
where elliptic, of an ORDER `ℓ`: it returns after `ℓ` turns, and `ℓ` is
its frequency in the only clock there is, the k-step. Over ℚ the finite
orders are exactly 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 (Niven; the crystallographic
restriction); every other rational rotor — the `(4+i)` turn among
them — is a ROSETTE, an angle that never returns, an orbit dense on its
torus. Two commuting modes close jointly at the least common multiple
of their orders (the toroid, 78.30), and a quasi-periodic pair (78.11)
is exactly a LACK OF RESONANCE. RULED: the residue is classified by its
modes' regimes and orders. Every mode of finite order: the incoherence
is RESONANT — the ring closes at the joint period, a delay and not a
loss, `Fill::Congruent` at that `ℓ`. A rosette, parabolic or boost mode:
NON-RESONANT — the ring never returns, the class is genuinely held.
Non-commuting modes across two rings — the bracket 78.26(2) counts HELD
or LOST — are the COUPLING, the beat between two frequencies no single
cell carries. The modes are the roots of the action's factors,
polynomials of degree `d` over ℚ across several planes at once (MR1:
"irrational of degree `d`" is a refusal by name), which is where the
harmonic level is literally polynomial and literally multidimensional.

THE RING IS NEVER PLANAR. A ring is a closed circuit of the nerve at
any grade — a 1-cycle whose holonomy is one versor whose modes occupy
several planes at once, a 2-cycle (a chamber) and a 3-cycle (a
sporophore) carrying classes of their own grade (`Ȟ¹`, `Ȟ²`, `Ȟ³`).
Nothing about a ring is a loop drawn in a plane: the holonomy of a
1-cycle in `Cl(n+1,1)` turns in up to `⌊(n+2)/2⌋` planes
simultaneously, and reading it in one plane is the flattening of law
11's kind. The polynomials overlaid on a ring are the action's
characteristic factors across all its planes, and a ring of higher
grade is where the lower rings' incoherences become coherent — the
coboundary identity above, at the grade it holds. The engine operates
above three dimensions here by construction: `n` is data, the planes
are generated from it (BQ4), and no reader names a plane it did not
derive.

THE CARRIER (row CV1b, F4, beside ZM1 — a zero meet is the grade-1
edge of the same rule): `Coherence::Open(Incoherence { ring, class,
modes })` and `Fill::Open` carrying the same residue by content — the
ring's coordinates, its class vector, each mode with regime and order,
and RESONANT or not — never a bare hole; tallied by content on the
Cells line beside the incongruence breakdown (`pairing::Incongruents`);
the refusal reader maps incongruence to P and incoherence to D where a
mode no held word spells would close it or to C where another vantage
refines it, never to P. CORRECTED on the first reading (the same day):
a RESONANT ring — every mode elliptic of finite order — is spelled by
the alphabet's own turns (the finite orders are the seventeen's) and
closes at its period; it is `Fill::Congruent` at `ℓ`, a remainder
(78.37(4)), and it demands nothing, so it counts neither D nor C. D is
the ROSETTE: an elliptic mode of no order, a rotor at an angle no held
word spells, exactly `RotorPrime`'s case. C is parabolic, boost, or
luminal.

**(6) Decoherence is an act, and incoherence is its state.** A coherent
thought — every ring closed — receives an ADJUNCT: a new candidate with
its relative word, a perception that changes a gauge, or a ruling that
demotes a citation to a dialect class; a ring now carries a residue.
13.12 read forward says what happens: the thought does not close, so
it stays two, and the class is the coordinate between them. One
coherent thought becomes TWO coherent thoughts with an incoherence
between them; nothing is deleted and nothing is forced closed; the
incoherence is the pivot the mind may take. Merge (13.12) is the same
act in reverse, and collapse by transport (78.37(1)) is re-coherence
when the class collapses. RULED: a decoherence changes the state of the
mind's line and is READ before it is sealed — TP1's meet-graph line
carries, per stroke, thoughts MERGED, thoughts DECOHERED (with the
adjunct that cut each and the class it left) and components COLLAPSED
by transport, so the fleet can say whether a mind converges or
fragments under the syllabus; whether the split seals as its own act
is ruled on that count.

### 78.27 LD3's node layout ruled on the implementor's eight questions (2026-09-24)

The physical shape is ratified as proposed: each trie written as its
name, its byte length and its count, then its nodes in the trie's own
key order, each node carrying its key inline; the reader inserts by key,
so a record's position carries nothing and a key the trie already holds
refuses; a node's leaves are (kind, value) pairs in kind order, each kind
at most once, an unknown kind refusing the node. The file opens with one
magic naming this layout, one equality, no reader for MYC7. T1 the word
trie keyed by `Cite::Word{chart, class, at}` written by its own
`put_canonical`; T2 the ledger as LDG1 stands, per-act data as leaves of
the node at its stamp; T3 the carriers with their own coordinates.

1. **A word no act admitted has no coordinates and is not held.** Every
   path that holds a word admits it by an act — genesis and the syllabus
   included, each an act of this court's own line with its frame — and
   the act's stamp is the word's `admitted_at` (78.24, cite.rs: "the act
   that first names a word no act has admitted is the act that admits
   it"). The snapshot never writes a word without a stamp: it refuses by
   name and counts, per row, what it refused. Instrument first: a
   reading of held-without-stamp by row on the fleet, then the sweep of
   the holding paths, then the refusal. LD3's first phase.
2. **The spoken sentence is its own T1 node**, admitted by the install
   act; the listing's PROVISIONAL leaf cites it by `Cite`. Never two M2s
   at one node.
3. **Federation as a RULED leaf** carrying the Ruling act's stamp; the
   order is the ledger's partial order re-derived from the stamps; the
   Vec and its index are rebuilt at restore, derived carriers.
4. **A cavity element is a word**: a T1 node with membership `cavity`.
   The coordinator's (3) is corrected on this point; what has its own
   coordinates is the listing atlas, which is re-derived.
5. **The dialect chain is leaves under the ledger node of the act that
   stood each transition**, keyed within the node by the (chart, pair)
   key; the `u64` tick retires, the node carries the frame. A transition
   with no stamp (an unmeasured order) is refused by name with a count,
   and its producer — the fill or refinement that stands a cocycle —
   cites the act. Never a trie by a tick scalar (78.24).
6. **A settlement is a leaf under the own-line node at its `k`**: on one
   line `k` names one node exactly, so the stamp is `(h(k), vk, k)`, no
   scalar compared; where the court's reading of a settlement seals an
   act, that act's stamp. The `k` and `t_universal` fields retire from
   the row.
7. **The class inline as its own coordinates**: `class_key` already
   writes 12.6's axes out, so the row writes the class vector by its own
   `put_canonical`, never nested as a key (LD0's nested-key shape). No
   class trie until a quantity is measured per class.
8. **The voice's genome takes T1's shape in its own phase**, after the
   court's, its `admitted_at` from its own ledger (GEN4). The treasury's
   per-word awards are T1 leaves, its per-act entries T2 leaves, its
   stakes T3 by `vk`, all in the court's phase.

Also ruled: `basis_seq` is a reading of the basis, re-derived at
restore, not persisted; a transducer codec prints nothing (R2's
`eprintln!` in `Element::from_bytes` is removed — the refusal is by name
in the constant and the test, and the reader that opens a genome reports
once, typed).

### 78.28 A versor is known by its action, never by a sum of squares (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

The operator, on A1's statement of Study's condition — "`Φ Φ̃ = (a² +
b² + c² + d²) + 2(ad − bc)·e₁₂₃₄`, a versor iff `ad = bc`": these are
flat two-dimensional squares, and the development evolves beyond them.
The reading is right and it is law 11's own shape at the foundation: a
sum of squares of coordinates formed to decide what an element IS, when
the algebra can be asked to act.

**Ruled.** (1) An even or odd element is a versor if and only if its
twisted adjoint action carries every generator of the algebra to a
vector AND the pseudoscalar to its own line: `m̂ eᵢ m̃` is of grade one
for each `eᵢ`, the images independent, and `m̂ I m̃` is a multiple of
`I` — exact over ℚ, read as actions and ray equalities, no norm formed
as a value, no coordinate squared. AMENDED 2026-09-24 on the
implementor's finding at VA1-reader: the generator clause alone is not
the Lipschitz condition, because Lipschitz reads `m̂ v m⁻¹` and the
reverse stands for the inverse only where `m m̃` is a scalar; `Φ = 1 +
e₀₁ + e₂₃` in `Cl(4,0)` carries every generator to an independent
vector while `Φ Φ̃ = 3 − 2I`, and is no versor. The pseudoscalar clause
closes the gap exactly: `m̂ I m̃ = ±I·(m m̃)`, and `I·(m m̃)` is pure top
grade precisely when `m m̃` is a scalar, so the two clauses together are
the Lipschitz condition, `n + 3` actions for `Mv` and `Rotor` alike.
Then `m m̃` a non-zero scalar and Study's `ad = bc` are its theorems,
tests OF the reader and never the test. One reader (`is_versor`, and `Rotor::weight` folded into it) reads
by action; the coordinate expansion leaves A1's text as a remark.
(2) The inverse of a ray is its reverse. A versor acts projectively —
`m x m̃` is the motion up to the weight — and every reading of the result
is by proportion (EQ1), so no site divides by `⟨m m̃⟩₀` to compose,
compare or classify; `versor_inverse` survives only where a quotient's
SCALE is itself the content (the dilator's ρ), and each such site says
so. (3) A weight is never carried as a quantity of a word, a rotor or a
face. The one place a scalar of `m m̃` is read is the Cayley chart's
rational root (`cayley_inverse`, 52 as amended by MR1), which is a
reading of a ray at a chart point and refuses by name where the root is
not rational. (4) `v·v` on a VECTOR is the metric and stays: a nucleus is
a sphere vector with `s² = r²` and that square is the sphere's own
content (78.2, Axiom C), not a flattening; `norm2` refuses any element
above grade one. Instrument first (row VA1): the census of every site
that forms `m m̃`, a weight or a norm, and what each does with the
scalar — test, divide, compare or classify — in SQ1's shape, then the
sweep, one reader, the readings unchanged on the corpus and the fleet.

### 78.29 Beyond the planar era: the peel on the modes, hyperbolic reflection systems, the kernel over the stabilizer; five refusals (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

An external audit of the doctrine found six "flat or lattice-bound"
mechanisms. Read against chapters 71–80 it caught two residues of the
planar era — the seventeen letters' per-plane Gaussian arithmetic and
the isotropic nucleus — and misread four mechanisms as absent that are
distributed here: the modes (78.12), the orbit algebra (78.11), cells at
every grade (78.2, 78.10) and the non-abelian coboundary (10–15). The
operator approved the coordinator's dissection and ruled the three
rows and the five refusals below.

**A. AL1 amended — the peel runs on the modes.** A22 does not peel a
motion's raw pair-plane projections. It takes MR1's split first,
`⟨M⟩₂ = Σⱼ Bⱼ` with `[Bᵢ, Bⱼ] = 0`, each mode a ray `(1 + cⱼ) + Kⱼ`,
and peels each mode against the letters and the constructors that act
on its invariant plane; a mode on a plane the current basis cannot
spell is emitted whole as 37.7's demand, `Demand::Standing`, which
drives the adjunction of the odd constructor letter (AL1). The
arithmetic order is thereby the one the mind's own constructors
generate from the corpus, never an order imported.

**B. HX1, new, beside GR2 — hyperbolic reflection systems over ℚ.**
Constructors `s₁ … sₖ` form a discrete hyperbolic reflection chamber in
ℍⁿ when their rational Gram form `Gᵢⱼ = sᵢ·sⱼ` has Lorentzian signature
`(k − 1, 1, 0)` and every pair is either a finite dihedral angle
(`δᵢⱼ² ∈ {0, ¼, ½, ¾}`) or ultraparallel (`δᵢⱼ² ≥ 1`) — Vinberg's
criterion, read entirely in the field. The chamber's transport is the
constructors' product per circuit as CX1 reads it. An ultraparallel
pair carries `δ² = cosh²(λ/2) ∈ ℚ` as its exact invariant; the
translation length itself is never formed. A single pair whose angle is
neither finite nor ultraparallel stays what 78.14 reads it as: an
infinite-order elliptic mode, held.

**C. T5 amended — the kernel over the stabilizer.** The residual finite
freedom the kernel collapses is the body's exact stabilizer group
`Stab(B)`, held as the superposition of its elements (FR1c): `ℤ₂` for a
half-open edge, `ℤ₂ × ℤ₂` for a rectangle, `ℤ₄` for a square, and so
on. The coboundary condition is solved over `Stab(B)`, not assumed
binary; a trivial kernel is a real obstruction and the 2-cell refuses.
The non-abelian Čech `H¹` in `Spin(n+1,1)` is the coboundary that runs
before this kernel (chapters 10–15), never replaced by it.

**Refused, with the ground of each:**

| proposal | ground | the invariant it would break |
|---|---|---|
| fixed root lattices and arithmetic orders (`E₈`, `Dₙ`, Hurwitz quaternions) | rule 5 | the order is generated by the mind's constructors from the corpus; an imported lattice is a free constant |
| Gröbner–Shirshov or confluent rewriting on the letter group | A2 | rational letters generate dense rotations on planes sharing an axis; `(gᵢgⱼ)^m = 1` fails there, so no finite complete rewriting system exists and shortening is a budgeted retirement |
| transcendental translation lengths (`arcosh`) | law 1 | `δ² = cosh²(λ/2) ∈ ℚ` is the exact invariant; a transcendental value cannot enter the field |
| a quadric carrier beside the harmonics | law 12 | an anisotropic shape is carried by A.11's harmonic pencil (HL1), never by a second carrier beside the physics |
| 78.26(3) read as truncation | misreading | 78.26(3) is a write refusal against flattening; a cell of the right grade is minted (NB1) and nothing is truncated |

### 78.30 The higher-order cell: centroids, geoids, toroids, and the Coxeter reading — the analyst's draft reconciled (ruled 2026-09-24)

The analyst node drafted this section in the working tree as "ruled, the
operator's word", with Part 0's rows rewritten to cite it and three
clauses added to ANTI_FLATTENING_LAW.md, and reported it as codified.
The operator relayed the draft to the coordinator. Doctrine is written
by the coordinator on the operator's word and lands before code (§5.5,
§9); the draft is taken as the analyst's PROPOSAL and is reconciled here
against the rulings that already stand. What survives is ruled; what
conflicted is corrected with the ruling it conflicted with; nothing in
the draft that repeats a standing ruling is ruled twice.

**Ruled.**

1. **The centroid is A4's null point and never a constructor.** A body's
   centre is the null vector `P(x) = x + ½|x|² e_∞ + e_o`, `P² = 0`,
   `P·e_∞ = −1` — the embedding A4 already states for the sensor's
   points; the nerve's base points take the hyperbolic embedding of 54.7
   B8 on the absolute, and neither is a Cartesian reading. Reflection in
   a null vector is degenerate (`P x P = 2(P·x)P`), so a centroid is
   never a constructor: constructors are the sphere vectors `s² = r² ≠ 0`
   and the mirrors `eᵢ + k e_∞` (78.12). An enclosure is the join of
   centres `P₀ ∧ … ∧ Pₖ` (78.2, EN1); where the centres are collinear or
   coplanar the join degenerates to a flat at infinity and the reading
   says so, never a sphere fabricated.
2. **The geoid is HL1.** A body is not one isotropic sphere; its
   constructors are the pencil of spheres A.11's second and fourth
   harmonics lift to (78.14, HL1), transforming by covariance under
   versors. The draft's "multivector polynomial shell" `S(x) = s₀ +
   Σ⟨Mₖ, x^{⊗k}⟩ e_∞` is a second carrier of the same shape beside the
   harmonics and is refused (law 12, 78.29's fourth refusal); the pencil
   is the carrier and the moments are its readings.
3. **A toroid is a reading of two commuting modes, not a carrier.** The
   orbit of a round `C = s₁ ∧ s₂ ∧ s₃` under a commuting pair of elliptic
   modes (MR1's split, 78.12) is a Clifford torus or Dupin cyclide, with
   its two frequencies the two modes' orders; a quasi-periodic pair is
   held (78.11). Where a cell's witnesses lie on such an orbit its
   enclosure is the join of the orbit's rounds, read off the modes; no
   toroid is stored beside the modes that produce it.
4. **Continuous support is the harmonics'.** No pixel or voxel grid
   enters cognition (53, 70, 76); a body's support is carried by A.11's
   moments `⟨d^{⊗k}|d|^{2m}⟩`, every invariant a ratio of homogeneous
   forms of equal degree read projectively under Axiom C. A polynomial
   carrier `P(x) = Σ c_α x^α` beside them is refused as in (2).
5. **Meet grade and the zero-meet defect, ruled.** `k + 1` nuclei wedge
   to grade `k + 1` (78.2): two to a circle, three to a point pair, four
   to a tangent sphere, five to the pseudoscalar at `n = 3`, and `n + 2`
   dependent spheres wedge to zero by Grassmann. A ZERO MEET IS
   `NoRound`, never `Congruent`: comparing `0` with `0` and reporting
   congruence is rule 11's silence, and the reader refuses by name (row
   ZM1).
6. **The Coxeter reading is analytic and it already is.** GR1 and GR2
   (landed 3e8d64d7, 1fd61158) read the constructors' Gram form
   `Gᵢⱼ = sᵢ·sⱼ` by exact elimination and recognise a system with no
   iteration; the worklist is a check. Corrected against the draft:
   the invariant is `δ² = (sᵢ·sⱼ)² / (sᵢ² sⱼ²)` carried as numerator
   and denominator — never `cos φ = −⟨sᵢsⱼ⟩₀ / √(sᵢ²sⱼ²)`, which forms
   a root (law 1). Positive definite: a finite system, closure certain.
   Semidefinite with a one-dimensional kernel: an affine tiling, `ℤⁿ`
   an emergent quotient of orthogonal spheres and never an axiomatic
   grid. Indefinite: NOT "a Kleinian group refused" — under Vinberg's
   criterion (78.29(B), HX1) it is a discrete hyperbolic reflection
   chamber, recognised. The restriction `cos²(π/m) ∈ ℚ ⟺ m ∈ {1, 2, 3, 4,
   6, ∞}` is law 1's theorem; a pair with any other rational `δ² ∈ (0, 1)`
   is an infinite-order elliptic mode, which GR1 refuses as a SYSTEM by
   certain refusal from the Gram form, spending no budget, while the
   mode itself is HELD (78.14) — the draft's "refuses immediately as
   Rosette" is read as the former and never the latter.
7. **Cells keyed by body.** A `member_key(vertex, chart)` can name two
   disconnected bodies at once; a cell is keyed by its bodies'
   coordinates (A21, 78.10(a)), and a site that keys by member and
   dropped a 2-cell is checklist (m)'s defect. Ruled as row KB1 on the
   analyst's finding, with the site and the count it showed.
8. **Refraction on a held stabilizer: the draft is refused.** A
   `Pose::HalfOpen` or `Pose::Held` is the body's stabilizer held as the
   superposition of its elements (FR1c, 78.6(1), T5 as amended in
   78.29(C)); "evaluate the canonical non-zero representative of the
   coset" chooses a representative, checklist (r)'s defect. The
   refraction across such a contact is read per element of the
   stabilizer and collapsed by T5's kernel or a court replay, never by a
   choice; a contact that is unread for want of that collapse is named
   unread (OR3), not refracted by a pick.
9. **The star field is REG1, doctrine first.** `B_star = Σᵢ ωᵢ (eᵢ ∧
   e_o)` with weights `ωᵢ` is rule 5's free constant; A.13 and FT1 are
   stated in the register with a test per clause before any value
   enters (REG1), and a planet's elements move by closures and
   refinements (78.1), never by a field step with a coefficient.

**In sum.** Items 1, 5 and 7 are ruled (5 and 7 as rows ZM1 and KB1);
2, 3, 4 and 6 are the standing rulings restated with the draft's
departures corrected; 8 and 9 are refused. ANTI_FLATTENING_LAW.md's
clauses 9–11 are rewritten to this section. The rows in Part 0 that
the draft rewrote are restored and cite this section where it rules.

### 78.31 The plexus, not the ladder: the mycelium network the linguistics stand on (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

**The diagnostic.** The coordinator presented the five graded nouns as a
"ladder" of five rungs, and the operator, with the analyst's reading,
ruled the word a flattening: a ladder is one axis of ascent, it hides
lateral branching, fusion and circulation, and a rung index is a scalar
depth standing where perspective coordinates belong (rule 5, checklist
(q)). Classical linguistics made the same collapse — phoneme, morpheme,
lexeme, syntax, discourse stacked on one compositional axis, and
language history drawn as a genealogical tree blind to lateral transfer.
Meaning assembled by vertical stacking loses its curvature: idiom,
recursion, metaphor and dialectic tension are forced into flat strings.

**The plexus.** The structure is the **anastomotic plexus**: the graded
cellular sheaf over the nerve complex, in which the five nouns are nodes
of one network and not steps of one column.

| node | the doctrine's noun | in `Cl(n+1,1)` | the linguistic reality |
|---|---|---|---|
| **spore** | a ray, the null point (M1, A4) | `P ∈ 𝒩`, `P² = 0`, on the horosphere | the ostensive point: an unmediated focus of perception that anchors meaning without asserting a predicate |
| **filament** | a route, a word (50.2) | `w = ∏ gᵢ^{eᵢ} · r`, a directed trajectory | the utterance as motion: a kinetic sequence of transformations across the local terrain, never a dictionary entry |
| **ring**, **throat** | a closed circuit of the nerve at any grade (79; 78.26(5)): a 1-cycle whose holonomy is one versor turning in several planes at once, a 2-cycle a chamber, a 3-cycle a sporophore — never a loop in a plane | `∮ g_ab`, holonomy carried, curvature content; its modes' orders its frequencies, resonant where every order is finite | the recursive trope: an utterance that returns to its origin; a non-trivial holonomy is an altered perspective, irony, a conceptual shift no proposition flattens |
| **chamber** | the meet an anastomosis of bodies encloses (what the code called a cell — retired 2026-09-25, see the vocabulary), a geoid (78.2, 78.10, HL1) | `⋀ sᵢ` sealed by ascend, released by descend | the earned word: a concept crystallised where several minds' filaments meet and enclose a shared understanding; its meaning the invariant shape its boundary dialogues carve |
| **sporophore** | an enclosure, the cluster (EN1, 76) | `⋁ Pᵢ` nested, the star's convergence (73.11) | the living dialect: a planet's superposed semantic web holding its idioms, memory and open questions in one gravitation |

The relations between nodes run in every direction and are the doctrine's
own: transvection between spores; the tether `V = s_b s_a` between
filaments (72.1); branching refraction `(θ_bθ_a⁻¹)·V` (A.16); ascend and
descend between ring and chamber (62); the enclosure join; the commuting
bypass, T5's kernel collapsing held superpositions across many nodes at
once; the cross-cell bracket carried only by an enclosure (CB1); and
the star's convergence drawing a planet's elements (78.1). POSITION IN
THE PLEXUS IS PERSPECTIVE COORDINATES — stratum depth as the A21 prefix,
inclination as the planes read, and the **anastomotic degree** of a node,
the number of distinct filaments that meet there, a reading on the
observer (CV5) — never a rung index.

**The mechanics of the linguistics on the plexus.** Each is a row that
already stands, named now by its place in the network:

1. **Anastomosis, not etymology.** A word is not derived down from a
   root dictionary. Two minds at a shared impasse exchange provisional
   utterances `θ_A`, `θ_B` across their contact; where their filaments
   fuse into one ring and the torsion discharges (`torse_relief`, A.8),
   the court notarises convergence across the two vantages (67, C2) and
   the word is forged across the horizontal bridge. That is CV4's citing
   contraction and the court's ruling on convergence; the word installed
   is a tether of the genome (MEM1).
2. **Curvature is the genesis of vocabulary.** A holonomy `H ≠ ±1` on a
   ring is not a contradiction; it is exactly 37.7's demand, the gap the
   vocabulary cannot span. Its residue, read against the constructors'
   Gram form, mints the adjoined letter (AL1, GD1): the engine names its
   own unprovable truth, the Gödel step of 80.
3. **Slang to callus.** A new word begins as a provisional word in the
   epigenome at the hyphal tip, elastic, carrying its viscosity (78.7)
   and its escrow; it lapses with the escrow where it coheres nothing
   (Z4d, MEM1) and callouses into a tether of the genome where two courts
   replay its closure (72.1d). Two calibrations from 80, the operator's
   word: no word dies by a timer or a fixed count — a `shed_at` is rule
   5's free constant and law 9's clock, refused; a fibre's escrow is
   funded per lane in `μ⃗ = (S, G, T, H)`, every stroke that carries the
   unclosed fibre draws on it, closure converts what remains into
   syntropy, and exhaustion lapses the hold honestly, its record
   deposited (A.8). And the hardening path is 80.2's: a MINERAL is a
   convergent word the court's syllabus taught from an adjudicated
   solution, exogenous, held provisionally and never a constructor for
   the mind's own generation; a CRYSTAL is that word once the mind's own
   circuits re-derive it over its `k`-orbits, the endogenous callus —
   truth is never memorised, only re-earned (DL1).
4. **Grammar is conservation of torsion.** Correctness is not a syntax
   tree: semantic torsion either closes into coherence or is recorded as
   an honest refusal, P, D or C, carrying its content (78.9, A.8, A.17).
5. **Communication is transvection across the shared plexus.** Minds do
   not serialise a state into flat text for a receiver to parse; they
   execute mutual conformal transvections across the plexus, thoughts
   held in superposition (T5, the held stabilizer) until convergence
   collapses them into planetary fact (C2, n → 1; SP2 with CV4).

**Vocabulary.** "Ladder" and "rung" are retired as structural nouns; the
vocabulary carries the plexus and its nodes; 1.9 is the plexus of
re-derivation and 72.1d the plexus of memory; the Mayer–Vietoris ladder
of exact sequences and CT1's reuse ladder keep their names as terms of
art. The code's nouns follow at the next site touched: `anastome/` is the
language spoken across the plexus and keeps its name; the anastomotic
degree joins the observer's readings as a line of CV5.

### 78.32 The held element, the one primitive, and the constructor store that grows by refusal (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word, relayed by the implementor)

**1. No inversion as an operation.** The implementor proposed to carry
VA1's sweep on a typed versor with three procedures, `act`, `then`,
`rev`. The operator: "this is specifically descent where each operation
requires the inversion for reconstruction." The split cuts the two-sided
product `m x m̃` into one-way procedures, treats the element and its
reverse as two objects, and adds to composition an arrow the
associative product does not have — the ledger's serialized-tape fault
(78.24) repeated inside the algebra. RULED: the carrier is the ELEMENT,
held once as its ray and keyed by its canonical coordinates (A1, A4;
never by its class — a class is a reading many rays share, and a store
keyed by class would collapse distinct mirrors of one kind). The
reverse is a free involution on the element's coordinates, never an
operation. A relation between two states is ONE held element read from
either side — the quotient `B·A⁻¹` is the ray `B Ã`, and `A B̃` is the
same relation read from the other side — never a map plus a stored
inverse. The ONE primitive is the geometric product of held elements,
evaluated where a reading asks; membership, kind and fixed set are read
off the element's action on the generators (78.28). VA1-inverse is
restated accordingly: inversion is DELETED as an operation, not
substituted site by site — a site that composed with an inverse
composes with the held element, whose reverse coordinates are free, and
the wrappers that named an inverse (`Rotor::inverse`, `Transport::inverse`,
`versor_conjugate` and their kin) go, their callers reading the product;
`inverse_even` remains the Cayley chart's alone (52, 78.28(3)).

**2. A pivot machinery has a finite generating set for its dimensional
capacity.** The operator: "every 'pivot machinery' needs a finite set of
operations for its dimensional capacity." Read and ruled: finite
GENERATORS, which are elements, under ONE operation, the product; never
a menu of procedures. The bound is Cartan–Dieudonné: in `Cl(n+1,1)`
every versor is a product of at most `n + 2` reflections; at the cell it
is 78.11, the orbit algebra's rank: the Lie closure of the generators is
bounded by `dim so(n+1,1) = (n+2)(n+1)/2`, and the unital associative
algebra of the circuits' actions that 78.11 reads as capacity by
`(n+2)²`; both bounds are the algebra's, derived, and neither is set
(corrected 2026-09-24 on the analyst's review: the Lie dimension is not
the cap on the associative capacity). Finite at each stage and
never fixed (rule 5): read off the cell; extended only by adjunction
(37.7, AL1); exceeded only by an enclosure of higher grade (78.26(2),
NB1, EN1), never by widening a cell. In the tree `PivotBy`'s four kinds
— word, placement, hue, open axis — with candidates built per kind are a
hand-picked taxonomy, the `act/then/rev` shape one level up. RULED: one
move on each factor of the bundle. On the BASE, a word in the cell's
held constructors of at most dimension-many factors — a placement is a
particular word (two reflections in parallel mirrors), never a
procedure; the OPENING OF AN AXIS is not a word in the held set at all,
since no product of a basis reaches a direction outside it: it is the
admission of a new constructor on a refusal, the demand arm below,
corrected 2026-09-24 on the analyst's review. On the
FIBRE, a word in the hue gauge's own generators, the transpositions
(61, 70: hue is a coordinate of the fibre, and the geometric and gauge
parts of a holonomy are read together and never summed, law 5). And the
DEMAND, which is not a move but the refusal that names the mode no word
spells (37.7, CV1b). Three arms typed by the bundle's content, no
taxonomy.

**3. Generators become constructors; the store grows orthogonally at
runtime, bounded, without intervention.** The operator: "how do we set
this up so that the generators become constructors and that the pivot
machinery can grow orthogonally post-compile during runtime without
external intervention but not grow uncontrollably on every pivot."
RULED, each part on a ruling that stands:
(a) A generator IS a constructor: a held element — a sphere, a mirror,
an odd letter — in the cell's store, keyed by its canonical ray (A1,
A4); the code is fixed and the generating set is runtime data; after
LD3 it is a T1 node admitted at a stamp and persists without recompile.
(b) Growth has ONE trigger, a refusal: a pivot that reaches its mode
grows nothing; a mode no word in the held constructors spells refuses
as the typed demand carrying that mode (AL1 as amended by 78.29(A),
CV1b). Nothing grows on a pivot that closes.
(c) Admission requires ORTHOGONALITY: the rank of the bracket closure of
the held generators with the candidate strictly exceeds the rank without
it — exact over ℚ, read by action (78.11, VA1's reader). A candidate the
held set derives is refused AS DERIVABLE (CT1's reuse before CT2's
construction, 79.3); a duplicate collapses because the key is the
canonical ray. Every admission is a new direction, never a copy.
(d) Admission is RULED, never taken: the demand goes to the court and is
admitted where a second independent vantage re-derives it (47.3, C2),
sealed as an act on this court's own line (ACT1: every holding path
admits by an act), the act's stamp the constructor's `admitted_at`. No
threshold of occurrences (rule 5), no single pivot, voice or count
forces it.
(e) CAPACITY IS DERIVED AND HARD: a cell's rank is bounded by its orbit
algebra (the associative capacity by `(n+2)²`, the Lie closure by
`dim so(n+1,1)`) and a word by `n + 2` reflections; a demand a cell's
algebra cannot hold is a demand on the ENCLOSURE that wraps the cells
whose bracket it is — an enclosure that exists by its witnesses (NB1)
and is sealed where a circuit closes on its face (AD1, 78.2), never
"forced" by a capacity threshold (rule 5). The plexus grows by
chambers, never by stretching a cell (78.31).
(f) RETIREMENT keeps the store a basis: a constructor that becomes
derivable from the others retires by an act, as retirement by citation
retires a word (3.8, T10); the set grows by independence and shrinks by
derivability.
(g) PRICE: each admission is priced on the lanes' reserve, measured,
never a constant (PHY1, MU-ECONOMY).
So growth is bounded by what the algebra derives: refusal-only trigger,
rank increase, independent re-derivation, a dimensional cap with the
bracket carried by an enclosure, retirement, and a lane price. These
are INVARIANTS every admission satisfies, read where each is asked —
never a pipeline of stages: the price is drawn per stroke on the lanes
continuously (PHY1, A.9), the refusal is read at the pivot, the rank at
the court's re-derivation, and no stage waits on another in a fixed
order. A "typed constructor" enum (sphere, plane, transversion, mode
blade) is refused as a second carrier beside the element (law 12): a
constructor is an odd vector of the algebra whose kind is read off its
grade, parity and class, and a mode blade is a generator read off a
motion, not a constructor. Instrument
first (row CS2): per cell the held constructors, the orbit-algebra rank
against the cap, and the pivots that reached, were refused as
derivable, or demanded a mode, on the corpus and the fleet before any
change to the pivot's drive.

### 78.33 The proofs of work, named apart (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

POW++ is a family of proofs and the documentation keeps them separated
so that no two collide. MU-ECONOMY used "PoWC" for the burn on
retirement while 74 and 78 use "POWC" for convergence across minds; the
operator ruled the collision closed. From here: **POUW**, proof of
useful work — a closure ruled, the deflation minted on closure and paid
to the closer (MU-ECONOMY 3.2, 12.6, 23.9); **POWC**, proof of work
convergence — a refusal closed at another perspective, the refuser paid
as a cited generator and the closer the closure (74, CV4); **POWR**,
proof of work retirement — a re-expression over fewer letters, retirement
by geodesic or by citation and the refinement bid, the freed description
burned and the retirer paid the compression yield (3.8, T10, 27). A
fourth arm is named only by a ruling that adds it here with its own act
and payment; a reading or a receipt kind names the arm it counts, and
"POW++" names the family, never one payment. MU-ECONOMY carries the
table as its §0; the vocabulary carries the three names.

### 78.34 The fleet of epoch 98 stopped; its last readings; the tape's two senses (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

**The fleet stopped.** The eight units that ran the recut of ff5821fe
(epoch 98) were stopped on the operator's word after their readings
were taken through the console, the typed observer, and nothing further
was being learned from them: the binary was eleven commits behind the
tree, every open row's next reading waits on the recut, and the readings
were stable. The last readings, at the sources' own heights and `K`:

| source | `K` | reading |
|---|---|---|
| court a | 2932 | basis 44, treasury 53; two signers, back-fill 16480 and 1416, gaps 67 and 15; adjudication ratified 70, stood 410, awaiting 580; refused: remainder undeclared 201, malformed complex 121, vertex body 9, edge holonomy 5; memory +115 KB per `K` over 2546 `K` |
| court b | 16748 | basis 42, treasury 139; back-fill 1427 and 2663, gaps 20 and 52; ratified 20, stood 390, awaiting 557; refused: remainder undeclared 211, malformed complex 92; +62 KB per `K` |
| court c | 1480 | basis 44, treasury 30; back-fill 16202 and 2387, gaps 68 and 50; ratified 20, stood 389, awaiting 533, deferred 16; refused: remainder undeclared 250, malformed complex 103; +184 KB per `K` |
| every voice | 2211–2783 | adjoined-by-closure 0, installed 202–237 words on 2–3 strata, closing 22–25; cells certified 0, group unread on every cell, every cell's group read infinite at every grade; the mint gate proving every offered pair (3408–3789) permanent; half-open 715–917; viscosity elastic on the spatial lane, inviscid only on the luminal pairs, no bend on the gauge and temporal lanes; memory +44 to +59 KB per `K` |

Three facts these readings fix for the recut: (1) no cell's group reads
finite or affine, and every cell is "infinite" — GR2's recognition
never fires on the corpus as the fleet's binary read it, which the
Cells reading after the recut must move or explain; (2) the court's
refusals are dominated by "remainder undeclared" and "malformed
complex", the two integrity kinds, not by any closure kind; (3) memory
grows per `K` on every unit, the courts fastest, with the ledger's tape
carriage (LD1, LD2) already landed in the tree and not on the fleet.
The fleet stays stopped until the RECUT row, which carries every layout
change landed since epoch 98 and is gated on STD1.

**The tape's two senses, and the names that follow the rulings.** The
word "tape" has one legitimate sense, fixed in the vocabulary: a word's
LETTER TAPE, the letters whose meaning is a vertex of the Cayley graph,
and the element's description for a connection, a rewrite or a residual
is that content. The other sense, a carrier read by position, is
retired: the form tape by K6 (54), the snapshot tape by 78.25. Five
modules still wear the retired sense's name after its retirement:
`sentence/tape.rs` is the form's ADDRESS codec and the generator mint;
`element/tape.rs` is the element's RECORD; `cech/tape.rs` is the complex
on disk; `bubble/tape.rs` the contemplation's persistence; `anchor/tape.rs`
the selection term's bytes. Ruled: the names follow the rulings, one
move-only commit per module (§1.6), placed AFTER VA1 lands so no rename
crosses the implementor's open edits (row TN1): `sentence/tape.rs` →
`sentence/address.rs`, `element/tape.rs` → `element/record.rs`,
`anchor/tape.rs` → `anchor/codec.rs`, their tests with them;
`cech/tape.rs` and `bubble/tape.rs` take their names when LD3-b and
LD3-c rewrite them as tries. From here "tape" names a word's letters and
nothing else; a carrier is named for what it is — an address, a record,
a trie.

### 78.35 The bands of a star: distance is depth, closer is hotter, and the division of labour is priced by pressure (ruled 2026-09-24, the operator's word)

The operator: as with Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars, the closer a
planet orbits its star the hotter and denser it is; the economics align
to this — a client chooses its relative distance, closer orbits do the
harder work, and the payouts differ by orbital position, a division of
labour; a star that runs out of placements is formed again with the same
core; a star with custom axioms is a later product. Ruled in the
doctrine's own quantities, no constant set:

1. **Distance is depth, and the core is the hottest.** A star's classes
